### Running time

```{r running-time, echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE}
end_time = Sys.time()
round(end_time - start_time, digits = 1)
```

### Useful code

If you want to change a certain part of the code using the following code in Unix:

```{r eval = FALSE, class.source = 'fold-show'}
#Rmd script
cd /Users/ema/Documents/GitHub/RelativeSize/r_files
sed -i '' 's/old_string/new_string/g' *.Rmd

#R script
cd /Users/ema/Documents/GitHub/RelativeSize/r_files/functions
sed -i '' 's/old_string/new_string/g' *.R
```

you want to share a dataset and get a reproducible object, use the following R code:

```{r eval = FALSE}
dput()
```

Save files to calculate the effect size of meta-ecosystems. 

```{r}
write.csv(combination_sets_isolated_systems,
          file = here("files_for_ds_metaecos_es", "combination_sets_isolated_systems.csv"))

write.csv(ds_metaecosystems,
          file = here("files_for_ds_metaecos_es", "ds_metaecosystems.csv"))

write.csv(ds_metaecosystems,
          file = here("files_for_ds_metaecos_es", "ds_metaecosystems.csv"))
```
